headline: 科比意國宅陷酷暑危機
context: 法國建築師科比意（Le Corbusier）設計的社會住宅，座落在法國南部小鎮菲爾米尼（Firminy）。這是一篇評論觀點：作者指出，今年夏天室內溫度飆到攝氏 40 度，法規卻不准許裝設遮陽百葉窗，讓這批被列為古蹟的住宅變得「無法居住」。另一頭，全球最大足球遊戲系列最新作《EA Sports FC 27》即將推出，評測形容技術面明顯進步，轉會系統也更貼近現實。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: When temperatures get to 40C inside, and French building regulations won’t even allow shutters, these tenants’ listed homes are simply unlivable The population of Firminy, south-east France, has been dwindling for decades. Its recent history is one of factory closures in a region built by steel, and locals tell me that many people leave for better opportunities in neighbouring Saint-Étienne, or to live in the Haute-Loire’s countryside. On the top of a hill, however, stands Firminy’s pride: l’Unité d’Habitation , an imposing tower of concrete designed by Le Corbusier. The architect’s final project is an oddity – a building for people, where two-thirds of the apartments are dedicated to habitations à loyer modéré (or HLM – social housing); but also a piece of history, whose facade and roof were listed as monuments historiques in 1993. sources.title: Le Corbusier’s social housing was meant to be the dream. In a summer of extreme heat, it is a nightmare | Anna Richards

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The all-conquering franchise’s revamps are technically impressive, its transfers more true to life – and its new grassroots social hub is surprising fun As if the world wasn’t sufficiently football-obsessed, it’s time to prepare for the arrival of its biggest football video game. EA Sports FC 27 (the franchise that used to be Fifa – what better time to no longer be Fifa-branded?) is due to be released on 25 September. I just spent two intense days in Vancouver, where the EA FC games are made, playing FC 27 and talking to its developers. With an annual franchise such as EA FC, it helps to have something fresh to entice regular fans, and FC 27 has a whole new element, entitled the Grounds. It’s a physical hub-type area, similar to the City as seen in 2K’s recent NBA 2K basketball games, but much more pleasant to frequent, split as it is into areas inspired by British, French and Argentinian street-football culture. threads_text:
科比意國宅陷酷暑危機

這是一篇評論觀點：法國建築師科比意（Le Corbusier）設計的社會住宅，座落在南部小鎮菲爾米尼（Firminy）。當地人口這幾十年持續流失，曾靠鋼鐵業撐起的小鎮，如今工廠陸續關閉。作者指出，今年夏天室內溫度飆到攝氏 40 度，法規卻不准許裝設遮陽百葉窗，讓這批被列為古蹟的住宅變得「無法居住」。另一頭，全球最大足球遊戲系列最新作《EA Sports FC 27》即將推出，評測形容技術面明顯進步，轉會系統也更貼近現實，還新增了一個社群互動的基層足球專區。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 7 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 科比意當年設計的社會住宅，現在成了酷暑裡的難題。這是一篇評論——地點在法國南部小鎮菲爾米尼，今年夏天室內溫度飆到攝氏 40 度，法規卻不准住戶裝遮陽百葉窗。當地人口這幾十年一直在流失，曾經靠鋼鐵業撐起的小鎮，工廠一間間關掉。換個輕鬆的話題，全球最大的足球遊戲系列，新作《FC 27》要上市了，評測說技術面進步不少，轉會系統也更貼近現實。
